stem: How is the excerpt from “What the Octopus Knows” organized to develop the thesis?

options.label: A
options.text: The excerpt classifies several expert observations into categories that reveal interesting characteristics of octopuses.

options.label: B
options.text: The excerpt presents descriptions of a famous explorer and his observations to explain the benefits of scuba diving for viewing octopuses.

options.label: C
options.text: The excerpt presents a chronological series of events to explain the narrator’s personal perspective about octopuses.

options.label: D
options.text: The excerpt introduces a cause-and-effect structure to illustrate the effect of human interactions on octopuses.

visual_elements: Multiple choice options labeled A, B, C, D
